name: fluxcut
description: Makes a product video from a goal. Installs Fluxcut's MCP server, the maker skill, and the long-wait timeout. Your agent drives the gates; you approve them and you publish.

interface.shortDescription: Make a product video in Fluxcut from Codex
interface.longDescription: Installs Fluxcut's MCP server, the maker skill, and a 300 second tool timeout so each wait can hold up to 4 minutes. The agent writes, films, and drives the gates. You approve them, and you publish.
defaultPrompt: Use the fluxcut-maker skill. Make a promo for this product.
